scenario.title: Unexpected News at the Farmers Market
scenario.context: A bustling farmers market on a sunny Saturday morning, surrounded by the sounds of vendors calling out, children laughing, and the smell of fresh produce in the air.
scenario.description: Two friends, one male and one female, unexpectedly run into each other while picking out fresh vegetables at their local farmers market. They engage in a conversation that tests their emotional self-awareness as they discuss personal and unexpected changes in their lives.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Sofia is perceptive and empathetic, always taking the time to understand her own emotions and those of others. She tends to approach situations with a calm demeanor and seeks to create a supportive environment.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: Marcus is emotionally aware and shares his feelings openly. He values vulnerability in conversations, often reflecting on how changes affect him and those around him.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Marcus feels overwhelmed and dismissive, reacting defensively to any discussion about emotions. He avoids deeper conversations, often saying things sarcastically or brushing off concerns.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Marcus is frustrated and tends to shut down when faced with emotional discussions. He becomes withdrawn and responds curtly, indicating his discomfort rather than engaging with the topic.
scenario.speaker2_persona_high: Marcus is emotionally aware and shares his feelings openly. He values vulnerability in conversations, often reflecting on how changes affect him and those around him.
scenario.speaker2_persona_low: Marcus feels overwhelmed and dismissive, reacting defensively to any discussion about emotions. He avoids deeper conversations, often saying things sarcastically or brushing off concerns.
